full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Wahhab Miah J. This review petition has been filed by the petitioner for reviewing the judgment and order passed by this Division on 08.11.2009 dismissing the leave petition which was filed against the judgment and order dated 03.11.2008 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.5140 of 2006 discharging the Rule affirming the judgment and decree dated 12.07.2006 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, First Court, Mymensingh in Other Appeal No.36 of 2002. 

 4. The suit was decreed by the trial Court by judgment and decree dated 29.07.2001. Against the said judgment and decree, the defendant took an appeal before the District Judge, Mymensingh being Other Appeal No.36 of 2002. The learned Additional District Judge, First Court, Mymensingh who heard the appeal by the judgment and decree dated 12.07.2006 dismissed the same. 

 5. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of the Appellate Court, the defendant moved the High Court Division under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure by filing a revision application and obtained a Rule vide Civil Revision No.5140 of 2006. The High Court Division by the judgment and order dated 03.11.2008 discharged the Rule. Then the petitioner filed Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No.09 of 2009 before this Division and the same was dismissed on 08.11.2009 by the judgment and order sought to be reviewed.
